featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Jamboree was honestly one of the best decisions I could have made for my TOEFL preparation. With the help of Jamboree, I was able to score 110 out of 120 on the TOEFL exam (Reading: 28, Listening: 28, Speaking: 29, Writing: 25).

She stood by me like a pillar of support until the very last day of the exam. I would highly recommend Jamboree to anyone looking for quality TOEFL coaching and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Meer Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: my experience with jamboree was amazing, and they are a huge part of my jump from a 1450 to a 1510. starting off with the faculty, they were genuinely amazing and really good at explaining concepts and helping us solve the difficult questions, and we were also made aware of the “trap” questions that usually come on the sat, which is why i was able to improve so much. along with that, the jamboree dashboard had so many full length practice tests that i was 100% prepared before my actual sat, and they also had topic wise questions for both verbal and quants which was really helpful. additionally, i could also see a detailed analysis of each of my full length test, including how much time i take to solve each type of question, how much time i spend on a wrong answer vs a right answer, a score distribution chart, and all of this really helped me know where i stand. also, the questions in their full length tests were at the same difficulty level as the actual sat, which is a great thing because most bluebook tests are easier than the actual exam. even their support team was really great at addressing any technical difficulties i faced, and they constantly updated me with even the tiniest of things to ensure i dont miss out on any important updates. the learning material they gave me was also quite helpful, since that gave me the exact strategies to solve each type of question on the sat. and lastly, the doubt solving sessions they had for each full length tests really solved all of my queries i had in the questions i couldn’t answer. overall, i loved the experience at jamboree and i would 100% recommend it to anyone who wants a structured learning framework to prepare for their SATs.

Kapil Sir.
I still remember his first lecture. He casually mentioned he graduated from IIT Bombay, and then asked us, “Why did you choose this path? What made you take up Business?” That one question wasn’t just academic, it struck a chord. His presence was magnetic, calm, and healing. Even a minute with him could ease the heaviest mental storms.

I’ve had days where I isolated myself, thinking that would help me study better. But the moment I opened my math book, I’d feel lost again. Not once did Kapil Sir make me feel like a failure. He didn’t just teach, he stayed. With every silly doubt, every anxious thought, and even during the small moments (over farsan snacks or a shared laugh) he was there. More than a mentor, he became the elder brother I never knew I needed.

This post isn’t because he asked me to write one. It’s because I owe him so much more than words

And then there’s Amar Sir.

The mentor who never kept a boundary. Who didn’t treat me like a student, but like a friend. Who reminded me without ever saying it out loud that I wasn’t walking this path alone.

You don’t come across people like this often. Teachers who don’t just clock in hours but invest heart and soul into a student’s dreams. Teachers who aren’t just building careers, but characters. Teachers who choose people over paychecks.

Amar Sir, you’re a man to be crowned. Thank you for standing by me when I didn’t even believe in myself. For celebrating my smallest wins and holding me up during my hardest days.

While IMS might officially provides six-eight MyPlan sessions, I must have had countless hours of guidance and warmth, and through conversations with Kapil Sir and Amar Sir. And those hours were more than sessions. They were lifelines.

To Nishtha Ma’am, Deepak Sir, Manav Sir, Debdeep Sir, Ashish Sir, Ankit Sir and Vinaya Ma’am, you’ve all been more than just names in a system. You’ve been the light that guided me through the darkest corners of this journey. Each of you made me stronger, braver, and better than I was yesterday.

A thank you to the people who held me up when I didn’t think I could go on.
Because sometimes, the right guidance doesn’t just change your score, it changes your story.
